title: The Siberian Trap
setup: Black took White's offered pawn, put the queen on c7 and jumped a knight to g4; White has just played h3.
hint: Your queen and one knight already aim at the same square beside White's king. Ask which white piece is still guarding it.
explanation:
## The Idea

The queen on c7 and the knight on g4 both hit h2, and apart from the king only the knight on f3 guards it.

{{Nd4}} attacks the queen on e2 and offers White a knight to take. Taking this one is fatal: {{Nxd4}} removes the last guard of h2, and {{Qh2#}} follows, with the knight on g4 defending the queen. White's best is to give up the queen instead.

Before you chase a piece, count who is guarding the square behind you.
